task: T29: design ruling on trading while the game is paused
open_questions: Owner: you asked for ONE step per pause. The ruling gives one LEG per pause (trade at the docked planet, then send). Is that enough, or do you want a hard one-action limit?
Owner: the first loop now takes about 2 cycles of the 30 (travel_cycles_per_leg each way). Acceptable for the tutorial, or do you want a shorter first leg?
UNKNOWN: whether selling a good at the planet where it was bought is ever profitable in trade.gd. Gameplay Programmer to check; if yes, Economy Designer must fix.
handoff: Verdict change on trade.gd, planet_panel.gd and the tutorial: replace instant travel with timed travel (travel_cycles_per_leg), block trading for ships in transit, show reasons on disabled buttons. GDD section 2 and change log updated. No balance.json change needed. Gameplay Programmer implements the ruling in details.ruling.

verdicts.item: Instant 'Send ship here' (ship moves at once, pause lets the whole loop happen)
verdicts.reason: Travel must take game time; this closes the pause loophole and matches the GDD's own travel_cycles_per_leg.
Not a trade step; spends credits only, no loop is possible from it.

verdicts.item: Buy 1 / Buy max / Sell all while paused
verdicts.reason: Allowed only when one of the player's ships is docked at that planet.

ideas.name: A. One action token per pause
ideas.feels: Strict and clear: one click, then you must run time.
ideas.risk: Tutorial needs about 6 tokens, so it needs a time-based refill number (new balance key), and Buy 1 clicks waste the token; frustrating.

ideas.name: B. Travel takes time, ships in transit cannot trade
ideas.feels: Natural: you load and launch, then watch the ship fly; pause is for planning.
ideas.risk: Needs ship states (docked / in transit) and an arrival timer; first loop takes about 2 cycles, which is slow for the tutorial but matches the GDD.

ideas.name: C. Paused means look and plan only
ideas.feels: Simple and honest: pause freezes everything.
ideas.risk: Does not fix the root problem, because unpaused instant travel still allows the loop in seconds; also annoys players who want to think and click.

ruling.chosen: B, with the pause rule: a pause allows one leg of orders (trade at the docked planet, then send).
ruling.one_step_means: One step = one leg: any buying or selling at the planet where the ship is docked, then one dispatch. After dispatch the ship is in transit and the next step needs game time to pass.
allowed_while_paused: Look at planets, prices, cash, ship list; open panels.
Buy a ship (any time cash is enough; no limit; the new ship starts docked at the planet where it was bought).
Buy 1 / Buy max / Sell all at a planet where a ship of the player is docked (unlimited clicks, they are all one step).
Send ship here for a docked ship (charges trip_cost at dispatch, sets ship to in transit with arrival = travel_cycles_per_leg cycles of running game time).
not_allowed_anywhere_paused_or_not: Trading with a ship in transit.
Send ship here for a ship already in transit.
Teleporting: the ship's location changes only on arrival.
ruling.what_resets_it: Nothing special for pause. The limit comes from the ship being in transit; it ends only when running game time reaches the arrival time. Time must run (unpaused) for the arrival to happen. Unpaused and paused rules are identical, so no pause-specific code is needed beyond not advancing the clock.

disabled_button_text.note: Show the reason as a tooltip and as a short line under the disabled button. Show a 'Space: resume' hint when paused and a ship is in transit.

tutorial: Buy a ship step: works paused, unchanged.
Buy energy at planet 1 and Send ship to planet 2: works in one pause (one leg). After Send, mission text: 'Your ship is flying. Press Space to resume time.' Highlight the Pause button.
On arrival (needs about travel_cycles_per_leg cycles unpaused): mission text prompts to sell energy and buy food, then Send back.
On arrival at planet 1: sell food, then the automated route question appears as already written in the GDD.
The game still starts paused; the tutorial must never require the player to do anything impossible while paused.
ruling.route_note: Automated routes already imply travel time; reuse the same in-transit state. Do not add any new numbers; use travel_cycles_per_leg and cycle_minutes from balance.json.
